description: React component for rendering a booking list item with detailed UI, actions, and badges in a booking management system.

methods.name: buildParsedBooking
methods.description: Constructs a parsed booking object with event type and metadata.

methods.name: isBookingReroutable
methods.description: Type guard to determine if a booking is reroutable based on routing response and team event type.

methods.name: ConditionalLink
methods.description: Component that renders either a clickable div or a Next.js Link based on presence of onClick handler.

methods.name: BookingListItem
methods.description: Main React component rendering a detailed booking list item with actions, badges, and attendee info.

methods.name: BookingItemBadges
methods.description: Component displaying badges related to booking status, rescheduling, reports, and recurring info.

methods.name: RecurringBookingsTooltip
methods.description: Tooltip component showing recurring booking dates and remaining occurrences.

methods.name: FirstAttendee
methods.description: Component displaying the first attendee, with special label for current user.

methods.name: Attendee
methods.description: Component for displaying individual attendee info with options to email or mark no-show.

methods.name: GroupedAttendees
methods.description: Component for managing and updating multiple attendees' no-show status.

methods.name: GroupedGuests
methods.description: Component for managing and copying email of multiple guest attendees.

methods.name: DisplayAttendees
methods.description: Component that displays all attendees, including first attendee and additional ones.

methods.name: AssignmentReasonTooltip
methods.description: Tooltip badge showing assignment reason with localized text.
